GitHub - DeadlockCode/voxel_ray_traversal
Voxel Ray Traversal Welcome to the official repository for this YouTube video: This repository implements a voxel ray traversal algorithm based on the 1987 paper by Amanatides and Woo, A Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm for Ray Tracing. The core implementation of the traversal algorithm and rendering is in shaders/traverse.comp.
